question: In the year 2021, the sportspersons who won the most Arjuna Awards were associated with which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Hockey**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arjuna Award** is India's **second-highest sporting accolade **which is given to** sportspersons **who have** excelled in both National and International competitions** and possess **leadership qualities and a strong moral character.**
 
• This award was given to Indian sportspersons from **1961** till now.
 
• The **President of India **honours the awards the winners with a cash prize and also a bronze statue of Arjuna.
 
• In 2021, according to the statistics there are **35 awardees out of which 17 of them were hockey players** from India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hockey** 

 
 
• **Hockey **refers to a family of summer and winter team sports that evolved on an open field, dry floor, or sheet of ice such as a **gymnasium**.
 
• While the specific regulations, player counts, attire, and most notably the playing field differ amongst these games, they all include two opposing teams utilising sticks to direct a **ball or disc towards a goal.**
 
• Hockey comes in a variety of forms. Skates, whether wheeled or bladed, are used in some games yet not in others. The word "hockey" is frequently followed by another word, such as " **ice hockey," "roller hockey," "field hockey," "rink hockey," or "floor hockey," **to assist distinguish between these different games.
